comments.body: Shouldn't config:Indexable be capitalized since it is a class name?
a strawman implementation is part of this PR: https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/pull/13
As discussed on the 1-22-15 tech call https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/2015-01-22+-+Fedora+Tech+Meeting, this will not be a config# namespace, but rather a separate indexing# namespace.

The original PR has been updated to use an indexing# namespace. See https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/pull/13

This changes the currently documented use of indexing:indexable to indexing:Indexable to bring this in line with standard capitalization of owl classes.

Former user and A. Soroka, can you please give the new ontology in this PR a review and approval? With both of your +1's, I will then squash and merge. Thanks!
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/pull/13
